text: There is a contradiction among your answers. You are trying to keep living the way you have lived so far, even though it clashes with your beliefs — that phenomenon is called cognitive dissonance.
If you have been honest so far, it is clear that you have a sense of justice and empathy toward animals.
We understand that changing habits can feel hard, especially in an environment that treats those habits as normal.
Imagine a world where it is completely normal and accepted not to use animals.
If you fear judgment and exclusion, know that many people have had that fear
